properties.description: Azure Key Vault for this environment. Under the template defaults (Entra-only authentication everywhere) NOTHING currently resolves a secret through it - every connection uses the factory managed identity instead. It is deployed anyway because the moment you add a source that genuinely needs a credential - an on-premises SQL Server, an SFTP site, a partner API key - this is where that credential belongs, and adding the linked service later means re-testing managed private endpoint connectivity under time pressure.
